stem: How do fossil records support the theory of plate tectonics?

options.label: A
options.text: Similar fossils are found on the same continent at different time periods.

options.label: B
options.text: Similar fossils are found on various modern continents.

options.label: C
options.text: Different fossils are found on the same continent during the same time period.

options.label: D
options.text: Fossils found along coastal regions of modern continents are unique.
